plugin.setupCardDescription: Sell on Amazon: import orders, link and publish listings, keep stock and prices in sync.

setup.created: The connection is saved. Run the connection test to check the credentials with Amazon.
setup.description: Connect a Seller Central account through the Selling Partner API.

errors.awsKeysPaired: Enter both AWS keys, or neither.
errors.capabilityRequired: Choose at least one of orders or offers.
errors.marketplaceOtherRegion: A marketplace is served by another region. Choose marketplaces of the selected region only.
errors.queueUrlInvalid: Enter an SQS queue URL, such as https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/amazon-notifications.
errors.sellerIdInvalid: Enter the merchant token from Seller Central: 8 to 20 capital letters and digits.
errors.sellerIdRequired: The merchant token is required to manage offers.

setup.marketplacesHint: Orders are read and offers written on the marketplaces you choose.
setup.marketplacesNone: OpenLinker does not list marketplaces for this region yet.
setup.notificationsHint: With an SQS queue, Amazon reports order changes within a minute instead of at the next poll. You can add it later.
setup.offersHint: Link existing listings, publish new ones, and keep stock and prices up to date.
setup.ordersHint: Import Amazon orders and send tracking numbers back.
setup.readOnly: Your account can view connections but not create them. Ask an administrator to connect Amazon.
setup.refreshTokenHint: Issued when you authorize the app in Seller Central. It is stored encrypted.
setup.regionHint: The Selling Partner API region that serves your marketplaces.
setup.roleMasterHint: Coming soon: take products and stock from Amazon to sell elsewhere.
setup.roleSalesChannelHint: Products come from your catalogue; Amazon receives offers and sends orders.
setup.sandboxNotice: The sandbox answers with Amazon's sample data only. No real orders or listings are read or changed.
setup.sellerIdHint: Seller Central: Settings, Account info, Merchant token.
setup.sellerIdHintRequired: Required for offers. Seller Central: Settings, Account info, Merchant token.
setup.testUnavailable: The connection test could not run
setup.title: Connect Amazon
